label: gnome-telemetry-region-r4-owner-ipc

plan.parent_clarification: Parent clarification binds the whole loaded SessionConfig using canonical semantic JSON, keeps raw TOML SHA separate as client provenance, verifies driver.profile correspondence, and requires a real mismatch IPC refusal before capture; it also clarifies both atomic-admission race orders.

verification.owner_ipc_eight_sample_runner_and_negati: passed after semantic config binding and observable owner dispatch handling: test_paused_diagnostic_uses_actual_config_ipc_driver_and_eight_compiled_samples (1 passed in 33.56s; retained final focused rerun log). The fixture mutates only an actual ok:true response with a sample and fails explicitly with the observed dispatch if the owner refuses.

verification.ruff_format_check: passed on all seven owned source files

parent_hermetic_batch.failure_class: Both failures occurred during fixture setup because PRIVATE_TOOL_ROOT was absent while X11Backend loaded the authentic private xdotool artifact; they were not test assertion failures.

verification.parent_reported_actual_host_targeted_bat: 16 passed in 35.29s, tool session 99382; output was not retained as a file. This preceded the semantic-config correction.

parent_frozen_focused_failure.actual_owner_failure: DriverError: telemetry owner protocol deadline expired in region_capture; owner entered at 32682.065568208 and returned at 32683.072652957, without Shell capture or a published PNG.
parent_frozen_focused_failure.fixture_issue: The pre-instrumentation test handler assumed a successful sample, raised KeyError on the actual refusal, and hid the missing Shell capture behind an area-count assertion.

instrumented_intermediate_failure.failure: At teardown, the late-response fixture retried a bounded error write after the intentionally delayed client had disconnected; the retry hit BrokenPipe. Owner response and mutation cases had reached fixture teardown.

focused_retry_history.interpretation: The owner-side one-second deadline refusal is preserved and was not reproduced by the single corrected rerun. No timing budget or capture assertion was relaxed; the passing retry does not erase the earlier refusal or establish live timing reliability.

verification.fixture_dispatch_observability: For mutated runner cases, the fixture retains actual owner ok/sample/error/failure fields, changes a response only when it is ok:true and sample is a dict, and explicitly fails with the observed owner dispatch if no sample was returned. Late client disconnects are recorded as transport observations without a second socket write.

timing_evidence.scope: Per-sample timings are recorded by the private fixture; they are not live desktop performance measurements or a benchmark.
timing_evidence.existing_replay_measurement: The handoff records strict decode at 54.54ms median / 60.65ms p95 and PNG loading at 0.64ms median for a preserved real frame replay.
timing_evidence.unmeasured: Real desktop owner-IPC, Shell capture, PNG transfer, and end-to-end runner cost remain unmeasured by this R4 implementation.

open_review_questions: A parent focused run observed one actual owner protocol deadline expiry in region_capture before Shell capture; it failed closed and was not reproduced in one corrected targeted rerun. Review the retained logs and receipts; this implementation did not widen the deadline or claim live timing reliability.

semantic_config_binding.canonicalization: dataclasses.asdict(SessionConfig), recursively normalize pathlib.Path with os.fspath, sorted compact JSON, SHA-256
semantic_config_binding.raw_file_digest: Kept separately as config_file_sha256 client provenance; it is not treated as owner authority.
semantic_config_binding.owner_checks: Owner computes its own SessionConfig digest, checks the request before capture, verifies driver.profile equals config.profile, and rechecks profile/config semantic binding at observer admission and after capture.
semantic_config_binding.negative_ipc: Real socket runner fixture changes only capture_dir while preserving crop and producer. Owner refuses before admission and Shell capture; no owner sample/artifact is created.

ownership_resolution: R4 uses the existing daemon owner and canonical lease; no alternate live lease is introduced. Live diagnostic execution remains unauthorized.
